lines.text: March. Tax season. And the receipts... were gone.
For weeks, the accountant chased the same clients. Emails. Calls. Sticky notes. Nothing came back.
Then a new detective took the case. A bot that asks for every document, sends polite reminders, and files it all in one folder. Case closed.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Document collection on autopilot. DM us DOCS for the free checklist. You're still the captain.
